text:
alina: Kickoff: we need a concise benchmark narrative for launch — 1 blog post, 3 reproducible charts, 25m webinar, routing for high-intent leads. Keep claims conservative.

mike: Agree. Priority charts: 1) cost-per-1k tokens vs median latency (hero), 2) tail latency p50/p95/p99 comparison, 3) cost-per-1000-responses by batch size.

joni: Webinar structure suggestion: 7m findings, 12m demo (batching/cache/quant), 6m Q&A + CTA. Demo must include copy-paste commands.

leo: Routing sketch: if downloaded_pdf OR clicked_dedicated -> AE+SE. If webinar_attendee AND company_size>200 -> AE outreach. Else nurture drip. Add "primary use case" on form.

mike: For hero copy try: "Faster responses, smarter economics." Subhead: "In our tests batch+cache reduced per-response cost up to 4x; typical slices 1.5x-2.5x. Methodology linked."

alina: Callouts: always include hardware (A100 equiv), prompt lengths, model family. Charts should link to eval scripts in caption.

joni: I'll draft the 2-paragraph blog lead and a one-pager outline. Mike can mock SVGs. Target drafts in 48 hours.

marketing-bot: Webinar created: https://cal.link/redwood-bench-mini — slots Wed 11am / Thu 2pm.

alina: Checklist: blog lead (joni), hero chart mock (mike), methodology note (mike+alina), routing JSON (leo), webinar slides (alina). Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:
